$comment: Community games and metrics whose results an account posts publicly. Each game is an account plus patterns; adding a game needs no code. resultPattern decides which posts are results; it and fieldPatterns are case-insensitive regexes whose named groups become fields. Groups named in personFields hold handles and go through the consent rules: an excluded person is left out and the result still reported. numberFields are parsed as numbers. winningPost: 'quote' resolves the winning post from the post the result quotes; 'none' reports the person only. historyDays: how far back the game account's posts are read for streaks and history. leaderboard: patterns for an all-time leaderboard post (entryPattern needs groups rank, person, score).

games.name: Top Chicken
games.about: Daily: the most liked post in a 24-hour window among people the game's maintainer follows or is followed by, for accounts under the Grace Limit (7k followers).
games.resultPattern: New Top Chicken! @(?<winner>[a-z0-9.-]+?)'s post got (?<likes>\d+) likes
fieldPatterns: All-time top chicken is (?:still |now )?@?(?<recordHolder>[a-z0-9.-]+?) with a score of (?<recordScore>\d+)
Window stats: (?<posted>\d+)/(?<eligible>\d+) people posted; (?<windowPosts>\d+) posts overall
games.writerNote: Bible R7: winning is a hero moment, so the winner may be named on air, subject to the opt-out rules. Never name or rank anyone who did not win.
